Safed Musli Powder Exporter: Overview of Safed Musli Powder

Safed musli powder is the dried, milled root of Chlorophytum borivilianum, a herb traditionally used in Ayurvedic formulations. Nutraceutical, herbal and wellness brands buy it for capsules, tablets and powder blends. Tradenest Naturals is a safed musli powder exporter and safed musli powder manufacturer in India, based in Surat. We dehydrate and mill the roots to a fine, consistent texture that is easy to work with in production. As a bulk safed musli powder supplier, we serve brands and distributors in the USA, UK, Canada and Europe. Each batch is produced to the agreed specification, so what you approve at sample stage is what you receive in bulk. We handle trial orders as well as regular commercial volumes.

Manufacturing and Processing Excellence

Good powder starts with good roots. Our raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. Incoming roots are inspected for maturity, appearance and foreign matter. They are then cleaned, dehydrated and milled under hygienic conditions. The dried roots are milled and sieved to a uniform particle size. Sieving also helps remove fibres and foreign particles. Because we monitor each stage, the finished powder stays consistent in colour, texture and moisture. You receive a clean ingredient ready for blending, encapsulation or further processing.

Quality Assurance and Compliance

Each lot is checked for moisture, mesh size and appearance before packing. As a safed musli powder supplier, we work from a documented specification agreed with each buyer. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. We also provide export documentation support for every shipment. What certifications and quality standards apply? Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business and an IEC registered exporter. We keep batch traceability on every lot. Our packaging protects the powder from moisture and light. If your market has specific requirements, please share them with your enquiry so we can review them before you order.

Applications Across Industries

The powder is used across several market segments. Nutraceutical companies use it in capsules and tablets. Herbal brands include it in traditional Ayurvedic formulations. Some food manufacturers add it to powdered drink mixes and protein blends. Its mild taste makes blending straightforward. What are the typical specifications (mesh, moisture, purity)? The standard powder is dehydrated and milled to 80-100 mesh. Moisture is below 7.0%. It is a single-ingredient root powder with no added fillers or carriers. Full details are given in the product specification sheet.

Packaging, Shelf Life, and Logistics

Good packaging matters for herbal powders that travel long distances. What are the packaging and shelf-life options? We offer stand-up pouches, fibre drums and export HDPE bags, as well as OEM and private label packing. The packaging limits moisture and light exposure. Stored in cool, dry conditions, the powder has a shelf life of 24 months. What is the minimum order quantity for safed musli powder exporter? The MOQ is 5 Kg, which suits trial orders and smaller brands. Larger and custom orders are reviewed individually. What is the lead time and how do I request a sample or quote? Lead time depends on volume and packaging, and we confirm it with each quotation. Contact our sales team for samples, current safed musli powder price per kg quotes or a custom specification.

Buyer Value and Wholesale Partnerships

Tradenest Naturals offers clear wholesale safed musli powder pricing for volume buyers. We ship worldwide from India and help with export paperwork. When you buy safed musli powder bulk from us, you get a supplier that communicates clearly and keeps the specification steady over time. That helps your brand deliver a consistent product to your own customers.
